Modified HP filter of many series

Source: R/batch.R
mhp_batch.Rd

mhp_batch() applies mhp_filter() to every column of a matrix or data frame and returns one long table, with the smoothing parameter of each series in an attribute. Series of different lengths can share the matrix: leading and trailing missing values are dropped series by series.

Usage

mhp_batch(X, max_lambda = 100000L)

# Default S3 method
mhp_batch(X, max_lambda = 100000L)

Arguments

X

a numeric matrix or data frame, one series per column; missing values only at the start or the end.

max_lambda

the largest \(\lambda\) of the search over \(1, 2, \dots,\) max_lambda (default 100000).

Value

A data.table with the columns series, t, original, trend, cycle and the attribute lambdas, a data.table with series, lambda and gcv (as in version 0.1.0).

See also

mhp_filter, fmhp_batch, batch_compare, plot_batch

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(us_macro)
X <- log(as.matrix(us_macro[, c("gdp", "consumption", "investment")]))
mb <-
  mhp_batch(
      X          = X
    , max_lambda = 100000
    )
attr(x = mb, which = "lambdas")
#>         series lambda          gcv
#>         <char>  <int>        <num>
#> 1:         gdp    683 0.0002819926
#> 2: consumption    534 0.0001753795
#> 3:  investment   1009 0.0063778004
